title: Gherkin: recursive upward right-now, project labels, dedupe
description:
## Intent
As a reader of multi-project standup, I want parent/initiative/project bullets recomputed from children with project labels and no parent+child duplicate text.

## Behavior
- Recursive upward right-now (LLM or structured reduce), not flat leaf dump
- Project labels on every multi-project bullet
- Deduplicate parent+child saying the same thing

## DoD
Observable Gherkin scenarios dual-runtime.
right_now_summary: The team is defining recursive rollups, project labels, and deduplication for multi-project standups.
